verdict.line: You lose if you eat a brush Cryptic Gaze into a full Death's Caress shield; you win every extended trade once his Q is down.

brief.thesis: Sion's only hard CC is Cryptic Gaze (550 range, 12/11/10/9/8s cooldown) — once it's spent he has no way to stop your E (Judgment) spin or your Q's silence. Your Decisive Strike silence directly denies his W (Death's Caress) shield cast, so the fight is decided by whether you engage before or after his Q is on cooldown.

theirWindow.when: Sion's Q is up and you're near brush
theirWindow.what: Cryptic Gaze has 550 range and OP.GG flags brush casts specifically — don't walk into unwarded bushes while his Q is available, since the stun lets him land Death's Caress and a full Enrage-boosted auto chain for free.

yourWindow.when: Right after Sion uses or whiffs Q
yourWindow.what: Close immediately with Q (Decisive Strike) to silence him before he can cast W (Death's Caress), then unload E (Judgment) autos — for 8-12s he has zero CC and is only hitting you with Enrage autos that cost him his own health.

powerCurve.note: Both have one trading tool, Q stun vs auto trades
E online, Conqueror stacks outlast Enrage self-damage
Your R threatens execute before his ult heals him
Cannibalism sustain and stacked max HP catch him up

start.why: Sion's lane plan is forcing autos through Enrage and landing Cryptic Gaze — the flat damage reduction and regen on Doran's Shield blunts both while your Perseverance passive ticks in behind it.

boots.why: 69.4% pick, 57.4% win rate — the attack speed lets you land more E/Conqueror-stacking autos in the trade windows after his Q is down.

core.why: First item in the 60% win rate, 15% pick path — the slow on proc lets you stick to Sion through his Enrage kiting.
Second item on the same path — attack speed scales your Judgment and Decisive Strike autos through extended Enrage trades.
Closes out the 60% win rate path — grievous wounds directly cuts the lifesteal from Sion's Cannibalism ult, which is otherwise his best tool to undo a losing fight.

situational.when: if he's kiting you with Enrage and you need to close the gap instead of just slow him
if he's stacked enough max HP from E kills that your autos are bouncing off armor
if you're ahead and want faster cooldowns to chain all-ins before his Q resets

runes.keystoneWhy: 41.4% pick, 57% win rate — OP.GG's own tip is to maintain Conqueror stacks, since extended trades are where your sustain beats his self-inflicted Enrage damage.

summoners.why: 91.1% pick rate at 56.3% win rate — Ignite closes out the solo kills this matchup already favors you for, punishing Sion before his 90s Cannibalism cooldown is back up to save him.

playing.title: Trade only when his Q is down
playing.detail: Cryptic Gaze is his one piece of CC at 12/11/10/9/8s cooldown. Track it and only commit your all-in once it's spent or whiffed.

playing.title: Silence before he shields
playing.detail: Open your all-in with Q (Decisive Strike) — the silence stops him from casting W (Death's Caress), removing his main damage-absorption tool for that fight.

playing.title: Avoid brush when his Q is up
playing.detail: OP.GG specifically flags Cryptic Gaze cast from brush at 550 range — hold position outside unwarded bushes until it's confirmed used.

playing.title: Let Perseverance reset the trade
playing.detail: After an exchange, disengage rather than chain-trading — your passive health regen outpaces the health Sion burns himself via Enrage.

playing.title: Respect level 6 Cannibalism
playing.detail: Once his R is up, extended fights heal him and nearby allies and grant him attack speed — commit only if you can burst him down before the leech outpaces your damage.

playing.title: Press your solo-kill edge
playing.detail: The data shows a clear solo-kill advantage for you — look to end 1v1s outright with E (Judgment) sustained damage plus R (Demacian Justice) once he's under execute threshold.

playing.title: Don't fear his E toggle alone
playing.detail: Enrage has no cooldown but costs him health per attack — if he's spamming it to win a trade, let him burn his own HP and finish the exchange in your favor.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (148-game Garen vs Sion sample); the mechanical reasoning and trade timing are my own read of the ability kits, not scraped data.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of Sion’s (Q) used from inside a brush. Close in and fight him when his skills are on cooldown. Focus on maintaining your Conqueror stacks.
